title: Cosmic Eye Monolith
description: A large blue spherical orb covered in moss and numerous smaller blue eyes sits within an ancient moss-covered stone archway. Orange ethereal smoke swirls around the structure against a dark starry background, with a large central realistic eye featuring a bright turquoise iris.
prompt: A surreal cosmic blue sphere covered in moss and sprouting dozens of smaller blue eyeballs on stalks, featuring one large central realistic eye with a glowing turquoise iris, placed inside an ancient moss-covered stone archway, orange ethereal smoke swirling around the base, set against a dark starry night sky, mystical and otherworldly atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting
